lines: Ae jazba-e-dil, gar main chahoon, har cheez muqabil aa jaaye
couplets.en: O longing of the heart, if I wish it, all things come before me.

lines: Manzil ke liye do gaam chaloon, aur saamne manzil aa jaaye
couplets.en: I take two steps toward my destination, and there it is before me.
O longing of the heart, if I wish it.

lines: Ae dil ki khalish, jal yun hi sahi, jalta to hoon unki mehfil mein
couplets.en: Burn on, ache of my heart, for at least I burn in their company.

lines: Us waqt mujhe chaunka dena, jab rang pe mehfil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Startle me awake when the gathering comes alive.
O longing of the heart, if I wish it.

lines: Ae rahbar-e-kaamil, chalne ko tayyar to hoon, par yaad rahe
couplets.en: O trusted guide, I am ready to set out, but remember this.

lines: Us waqt mujhe bhatka dena, jab saamne manzil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Lead me astray just as my destination comes into view.
O longing of the heart, if I wish it.

lines: Haan, yaad mujhe tum kar lena, aawaaz mujhe tum de lena
couplets.en: Think of me, and call out to me.

lines: Is raah-e-mohabbat mein koi darpesh jo mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: If trouble should cross your path along the road of love.
O longing of the heart, if I wish it.

lines: Ab kyun dhoondoon woh chashm-e-karam, hone de sitam baala-e-sitam
couplets.en: Why seek that kindly gaze now when one hurt can follow another?

lines: Main chahta hoon, ae jazba-e-gham, mushkil pas-e-mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: O longing for sorrow, let one hardship come on the heels of another.

lines: Ae jazba-e-dil, gar main chahoon, har cheez muqabil aa jaaye
couplets.en: O longing of the heart, if I wish it, all things come before me.

couplets.en: I take two steps toward my destination, and there it is before me.
O longing of the heart, if I wish it.
